def_en: 1) to fly, fly about, fly away
1b) (Hiphil) to cause to fly, light upon
1c1) to fly about or to and fro
1c2) to cause to fly to and fro, brandish
kjv: brandish, be (wax) faint, flee away, fly (away), [idiom] set, shine forth, weary.
expl: to fly; also (by implication of dimness) to faint (from the darkness of swooning)
etim: a primitive root; to cover (with wings or obscurity); hence (as denominative from )
